youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for good news you can't relax into.

He: Jesus... why can't I just enjoy this? 🙂
He: Offer letter came. Friends booked a table. First thought: what's about to go wrong?
Jesus: You've been braced for bad news so long that good news feels like a trick.
He: Last time something good came, it left fast. So I keep one foot out the door.
Jesus: Keep the memory. Drop the guard. This gift isn't a trap with a bow on it.
Jesus: Sit at the table tonight. Eat the whole meal. It's allowed.
Jesus: What good thing are you scared to enjoy? 👇

“Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.”
James 1:17 (BSB)

The meal is allowed. Sit down and eat the whole thing.

? What good thing are you scared to enjoy? 👇
